issues.description: Template Main.java contains a commented example that instantiates Seal/Pig/Goat with two constructor arguments (name, type), but the problem statement/UML and the reference solution define constructors that take only a single String (name). This can mislead students into adding an extra attribute/constructor parameter that is not required by the specification and may not match tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update or remove the commented example in template Main.java to use the specified one-argument constructors (e.g., `new Seal("Clarabelle")`, `new Pig("Doodle")`, `new Goat("Buttinsky")`) so it matches the UML/spec and solution.
